what: Pages through a stack of cards piled in the same spot, one at a time — Next: the current card tilts −10° and disappears over .5s power1.out, and from its 30% mark the body of the next card underneath turns on over the same length. Previous: the current card’s body switches off, and from the 30% mark the previous card appears from above tilted −10° and then stands straight. Pressing Next on the last card goes back to the first in reverse, and the tabs jump any number of cards (forward uses the Next direction, backward uses the Previous direction)

options.overlap: Point where the next section starts to turn on (share of the preceding motion), default .3
options.origin: Tilt axis (transform-origin), default is the value in the card css — for a top-right ribbon spot use ”89% 4%”
